# Copilot instructions

## Copilot instructions guidance

Always run the full test suite before committing. Always write clear commit
messages. Always prefer small, focused pull requests over large ones. Always
ask before making destructive changes. Always keep functions short and
single-purpose. Always add comments explaining non-obvious code. Always
double check imports are sorted. Always keep the README up to date. Always
run the linter and fix every warning before opening a PR. Always be kind in
code review comments.
